steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without recreating or searching for the event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Convert the published RFQ into an auction; the conversion dialog's individual reuse options are not observable by this step.
Open the vendor portal for the named Vendor A while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the converted auction's pricing round as Vendor A.
Have Vendor A lower the carried-over bid from 100 to 85 and submit it.
Confirm the revised vendor bid was accepted by the supplier portal.
Return to the buyer portal to inspect the auction ranking.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the converted auction and ensure Vendor A is present.
Verify Vendor A's revised 85 bid is ranked first against Vendor B's 90 bid.
Verify the auction ranks follow the lowest bid amounts across both vendors.
